scope: Selected source-backed equipment transitions for Carl and Princess Donut. Equip means explicitly worn or observed active; unequip retains possession, remove means lost or destroyed. Dates of later observations are not claimed as first equip times. This does not establish a complete loadout at every point.
coverageNotes: Existing Book 1 glove destruction and boxer replacement events remain authoritative and are not duplicated.
Temporary gear removal, transformation-related slot suppression, and later re-equipping are not comprehensively tracked.
Possession or an intention to wear an item alone does not establish that it was equipped.
The old crupper remains carried after the Book 8 replacement; its prior remove action is corrected to unequip in book-8-audit.json.
